The same eight ideas, made of paper.

Left: Codex's first round. Right: the same idea, composition and motion, rebuilt in the paper language of the approved Itach cover. Pick Paper, Original or Pass on each one.

How we got here

Codex broke the chorus into four beats, gave each beat a verb, then picked eight different physical mechanisms (touch, leaning letters, repair, balance, two paths, a saucer tower, threads, a shadow dance) so that every idea runs through all four lines.

0.0כשזה איתךSomeone specific changes the momentReach, approach
4.8כשזה ביחדCloseness becomes doing it togetherMeet, touch, lean, cross
10.5נטעה נגדל ביחדWe make mistakes and grow togetherTry, stumble, repair, grow, balance
15.5ואם ניפול אז ניסינו הכלIf we fall, at least we tried everythingTip, fall, land, help each other up

One question for you: Codex read the third line as נטעה, "we will make mistakes". If the word is actually ניטע, "we will plant", tell me. Directions 04 and 07 already show a plant growing, so either reading works.

01 · A small touch

Intimate photography

0.0: one hand reaches; 4.8: the other meets it; 10.5: fingers try an awkward little dance; 15.5: both flop onto the sheet together, still touching through 22.55.

02 · Leaning on you

Physical typography

0.0: the letters of איתך stand apart; 4.8: they lean into one another; 10.5: the small wedge helps them balance; 15.5: they tip and settle together, keeping the word readable through 22.55.

03 · Make something of it

Photographic collage

0.0: one hand holds a torn sea fragment; 4.8: a second hand takes the opposite edge; 10.5: both bridge the split circle; 15.5: the tear opens again and they make a new imperfect shape together through 22.55.

04 · Room to grow

Painted illustration

0.0: one figure steadies the pot; 4.8: the second joins; 10.5: their sapling grows as they counterbalance; 15.5: the pot tips and both land together in soft soil, holding hands through 22.55.

05 · Two trajectories

Optical motion study

0.0: amber moves alone; 4.8: blue joins its rhythm; 10.5: both trace a growing irregular weave; 15.5: they tumble downward into a loose shared loop that keeps moving through 22.55.

06 · At least we tried

Domestic visual wit

0.0: one mug waits; 4.8: its mismatched partner bumps beside it; 10.5: saucers build a ridiculous shared tower; 15.5: the stack collapses onto a folded tea towel and the two mugs end side by side through 22.55.

07 · A life we make

Textile drawing

0.0: one thread stitches forward; 4.8: a second crosses its path; 10.5: their imperfect stitches grow a flowering plant; 15.5: a few stitches unravel and both threads tie the loose ends together through 22.55.

08 · Our clumsy dance

Cinematic shadow play

0.0: one shadow steps into sunlight; 4.8: a second takes its hand; 10.5: their dance grows bolder; 15.5: a clumsy dip becomes a shared crouch and they help each other up through 22.55.
